questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A place where coins, medals or tokens are made
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place where coins, medals or tokens are made
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Mint'.

Key Points

  • A mint is a place where the new coins of a country are made.
  • The word 'Mint' is a noun.
  • Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A self-governing country or region
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A self-governing country or region
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Autonomy'.

Key Points

  • The word 'Autonomy' (noun) means the quality or state of being self-governing.
    • Example: Demonstrators demanded immediate autonomy for their region.
  • Synonyms for the word 'Autonomy' are "free will, self-determination, volition".
  • Hence options 3 is the correct answer.

Additional Information

  • Let's look into the meaning of the other given words:
    • Democracy: A country in which power is held by elected representatives.
    • Monarchy: A country that has a king or queen.
    • Anarchy: A situation in which there is no organization and control, especially in society, because there is no effective government.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Astronaut.'

Key Points

  • Let us explore the marked option: 
    • 'Astronaut' is a person who travels in a spacecraft. (अंतरिक्ष यात्री)
      • For example - The rocket boosts the astronaut into space.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore the other options:
    • 'Anchor' is a person who reports the news and manages reports by others on a television or radio program. (एक व्यक्ति जो समाचारों की रिपोर्ट करता है और टेलीविजन या रेडियो कार्यक्रम पर दूसरों द्वारा रिपोर्ट का प्रबंधन करता है)
      • For example - Arnab Goswami is an Indian journalist and television news anchor.
    • 'Chauffeur' is a person whose job is to drive a car for somebody else. (दूसरों के लिए उनकी कार चलाने की नौकरी करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; कार का वेतनभोगी ड्राइवर)
      • For example - The chauffeur drove them straight to the theatre.
    • 'Choreographer' is a person who composes the sequence of steps and moves for a performance of dance. (नृत्‍य-रचनाकार; नृत्‍य-निर्देशक)
      • For example - She was chief dancer and choreographer, he was bandleader and strategy-maker.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. One who does not take any alcoholic drink
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who does not take any alcoholic drink
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Teetotaller.'

Key Points

  • Let us explore the marked option: 
    • 'Teetotaller' is a person who does not drink alcohol. (कभी भी मदिरापान न करने वाला व्यक्ति)
      • For example - Neeraj, as a teenager, was athletic, a non-smoker, and a teetotaller.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Additional Information

  •  Let us explore the other options:
    • 'Perfectionist' is a person who always does things as well as he/she possibly can and who expects others to do the same. (ऐसा व्‍यक्ति जो अपना काम उत्तम रीति से करे तथा दूसरों से भी वैसी ही आशा करे; पूर्णतावादी)
      • For example - She's such a perfectionist that she notices even the tiniest mistakes.
    • 'Astrologer' is a person who is an expert in astrology. (ज्‍योतिषी)
      • For example - An astrologer advised building the shrine to counter the negative influences.
    • 'Vegetarian' is a person who does not eat meat or fish. (शाकाहारी व्‍यक्ति)
      • For example - I got used gradually to the vegetarian diet.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A person who listens to someone’s private conversation without them knowing
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who listens to someone’s private conversation without them knowing
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Eavesdropper'.

Key Points

  • 'Eavesdropper' is a secret listener to private conversations. (छिपकर बातें सुनेवाला)
    • Example: The country's cellular networks are vulnerable to eavesdroppers.
  • Therefore, 'eavesdropper' is the correct word for the given sentence.
  • Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

Additional InformationLet's learn about other given options:

  • 'Infiltrator' is someone who enters or gains access to an organization or place surreptitiously, especially in order to acquire secret information or cause damage. (घुसपैठिया)
    • Example: The infiltrator was identified and killed.
  • 'Spy' is a person who secretly collects and reports information on the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor. (जासूस)
    • Example: In the film, he plays a spy whose mission is to confirm the verity of a secret military document.
  • 'Secret Agent' is a government employee whose job involves getting secret information about the governments of unfriendly foreign countries. (गुप्तचर)
    • Example: The government kicked a foreign secret agent out of the country.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A large building with an extensive floor area, typically for housing aircraft.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A large building with an extensive floor area, typically for housing aircraft.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Hangar'.

Key Points

  • 'Hangar' is a covered and usually enclosed area for housing and repairing aircraft. (विमान घर)
    • Example: On take-off, he almost crashed into a hangar.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word for the given sentence is 'hangar'.
  • Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

Additional InformationLet's learn about other given options:

  • 'Shed' means a simple roofed structure, typically made of wood or metal, used as a storage space, a shelter for animals, or a workshop. (छप्पर)
    • Example: A bicycle shed.
  • 'Airport' means a complex of runways and buildings for the takeoff, landing, and maintenance of civil aircraft, with facilities for passengers. (हवाई अड्डा)
    • Example: They arrived late at the airport.
  • 'Bam' is used to show that something happened very suddenly or quickly. 
    • Example: I wrote the order and bam, I sent it off.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Dormitory'.

Key Points

  • Dormitory: a large bedroom with a number of beds in it, especially in a school, etc. (अनेक पलंगों वाला बड़ा शयनकक्ष (विशेषतः स्‍कूल आदि में))
  • Assembly: a large group of people who come together for a particular purpose (समागम, सभा, जमावड़ा)
  • Creche: a place where small children are looked after while their parents are working, shopping, etc. (माता-पिता की अनुपस्थिति में शिशुओं की देखभाल का स्‍थान; शिशुसदन, शिशुगृह)
  • Hostel: a place like a cheap hotel where people can stay when they are living away from home (घर से बाहर रहने का अपेक्षाकृत सस्‍ता स्‍थान; होस्‍टल, छात्रावास)
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A group of people, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A group of people, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Caravan.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer:-
  • Caravan - any large group of people, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together in single file. (कारवां; लोगों का कोई बड़ा समूह, आमतौर पर वाहनों या जानवरों के साथ, एकल फ़ाइल में एक साथ यात्रा करते हुए)
    • For Example - A caravan of cars and trucks.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of the other given words in the options:-
    • Circus - a travelling company of acrobats, clowns, and other entertainers which gives performances, typically in a large tent, in a series of different places. (कलाबाजों, जोकरों और अन्य मनोरंजन करने वालों की एक यात्रा कंपनी जो विभिन्न स्थानों की एक श्रृंखला में, आमतौर पर एक बड़े तंबू में प्रदर्शन करती है)
    • Troop - soldiers or armed forces; a group of people or animals of a particular kind. (सैनिक या सशस्त्र बल; किसी विशेष प्रकार के लोगों या जानवरों का समूह )
    • Gang - an organized group of criminals. (अपराधियों का एक संगठित समूह)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A place in a large institution, for the care of those who are ill
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place in a large institution, for the care of those who are ill
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Infirmary.
Key Points
  • Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer:-
  • Infirmary - a place in a large institution for the care of those who are ill. (बीमार लोगों की देखभाल के लिए एक बड़े संस्थान में जगह)
    • For Example - The general infirmary is the principal of numerous charitable institutions.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 3. 

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of the other words given in options:-
    • Hangar - a large building with an extensive floor area, typically for housing aircraft. (एक व्यापक मंजिल क्षेत्र के साथ एक बड़ी इमारत, आमतौर पर विमान रखने के लिए)
    • Hostel - an establishment that provides inexpensive food and lodging for a specific group of people, such as students, workers, or travellers. (एक प्रतिष्ठान जो छात्रों, श्रमिकों या यात्रियों जैसे लोगों के एक विशिष्ट समूह के लिए सस्ता भोजन और आवास प्रदान करता है)
    • Dormitory - a large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution. (एक स्कूल या संस्थान में कई लोगों के लिए एक बड़ा शयनकक्ष)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A group of stars
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A group of stars
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Constellation".

Key Points

  • Constellation: A constellation is a group of stars that appears to form a pattern or picture like Orion the Great Hunter, Leo the Lion, or Taurus the Bull. Constellations are easily recognizable patterns that help people orient themselves using the night sky. (तारामंडल)
  • Congregation: the act of coming together in a crowd or group; a gathering (एकत्रित होने की क्रिया; सभा, जमाव); the group of people who attend a particular church (चर्चा-विशेष में जाने वाले व्‍यक्तियों का समूह)
  • Planets: a very large round object in space that moves around the sun or another star ग्रह (अंतरिक्ष में एक पिंड जो सूर्य या दूसरे तारे की परिक्रमा करता है)
  • Astronomy: the scientific study of the sun, moon, stars, etc. (नक्षत्रों, सूर्य, ग्रहों तथा चंद्रमा का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन; खगोलविज्ञान, गणित ज्‍योतिष)
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. One who studies the occult meanings of numbers and their supposed influence on human life
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who studies the occult meanings of numbers and their supposed influence on human life
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Numerologist'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Numerologist'.
  • It means 'an expert in numerology (= the study of numbers in the belief that they have a special importance in people's lives)'. (अंक ज्योतिष में एक विशेषज्ञ)
    • Example: Throughout history, there have been patterns to thrill the numerologist.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.
     

Correct Answer: Numerologist.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of the other words:
Words Meaning
Astronomer an expert in or student of astronomy. (खगोल विज्ञान के विशेषज्ञ या छात्र)
Prophet a person who says what will happen in the future. (भविष्‍यवक्ता)
Astrologer

a person who is an expert in astrology. (ज्‍योतिषी)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Having no boundaries or limits
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Having no boundaries or limits
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Infinite'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Infinite'.
  • It means 'without limits; that never ends.' (जिसकी सीमाएँ न हों, असीमित, अपरिमित; जिसका कभी अंत न हो, अंतहीन)
    • Example: Supplies of oil are not infinite.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.
    ​

Correct Answer: Infinite.

Additional Information 

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
Words Meaning
Colossal extremely large. (अतिविशाल, वृहत्‍काय, बहुत बड़ा)
Enormous very big or very great. (विशाल या अत्‍यधिक)
Tremendous

very large or great. (बहुत बड़ा या अधिक)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A sentimental longing for a period in the past
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
A sentimental longing for a period in the past
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Nostalgia.

Key Points 

  • The meaning of:
    • Nostalgia: A sentimental longing for a period in the past. (अतीत में एक अवधि के लिए एक भावुक लालसा)
      • For example, She enjoyed the nostalgia brought on by the show. 
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Nostalgia.
  • Hence, the correct option is 4.
Additional Information
  • Let's know the meaning of the other words:
Word
Meaning
Craving
an abnormal desire or longing. (एक असामान्य इच्छा या लालसा)
Emotion 
a strong feeling (such as love, anger, or fear). (एक मजबूत भावना (जैसे प्यार, क्रोध, या भय))
Memory
something that is remembered. (कुछ ऐसा जो याद किया जाता है)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A news article that reports the recent death of a person
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A news article that reports the recent death of a person
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Obituary'.

Key Points 

  • Let's explore the options:
    • Obituary: a report, especially in a newspaper, that gives the news of someone's death and details about their life (एक रिपोर्ट, विशेष रूप से एक समाचार पत्र में, जो किसी की मृत्यु की खबर देती है और उनके जीवन के बारे में विवरण देती है)
    • Review: to think or talk about something again, in order to make changes to it or to make a decision about it (किसी चीज़ के बारे में फिर से सोचना या बात करना, उसमें बदलाव करने या उसके बारे में निर्णय लेने के लिए)
    • Mortuary: a building, or a room in a hospital, etc. where dead bodies are kept before they are sent to be buried or burned, sometimes so that they can be examined (एक इमारत, या एक अस्पताल में एक कमरा, आदि जहां शवों को दफनाने या जलाने के लिए भेजे जाने से पहले रखा जाता है, कभी-कभी उनकी जांच की जा सकती है)
    • Editorial: an article in a newspaper that expresses the editor's opinion on a subject of particular interest at the present time (एक समाचार पत्र में एक लेख जो वर्तमान समय में विशेष रुचि के विषय पर संपादक की राय व्यक्त करता है)
  • Thus, from the above meanings correct one-word substitution for the given question is 'Obituary'.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. To throw an event into confusion or disorder
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To throw an event into confusion or disorder
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e., 'Disrupt'.

Key Points

  • Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
    • Disrupt - interrupt (an event, activity, or process) by causing a disturbance or problem. (बाधित)
    • Detonate - explode or cause to explode. (विस्फोट)
    • Erupt - break out suddenly and dramatically. (फूटना)
    • Explode - burst or shatter violently and noisily as a result of rapid combustion, excessive internal pressure, or another process. (विस्फोट)
  • From the above meanings, it is clear that disrupt is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
  • Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. The act or habit of talking in one's sleep
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The act or habit of talking in one's sleep
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e., 'Somniloquy'.

Key Points 

  • Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options -  
    • Monologue - a long speech by one actor in a play or film, or as part of a theatrical or broadcast programme.
    • Prologue - a separate introductory section of a literary, dramatic, or musical work.
    • Somniloquy - also known as sleeptalking, is defined as talking during sleep “with varying degrees of comprehensibility.
    • Soliloquy - an act of speaking one's thoughts aloud when by oneself or regardless of any hearers, especially by a character in a play.
  • From the above meanings, it is clear that somniloquy is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
  • Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A person who thinks that bad things are more likely to happen or who emphasises the bad part of a situation
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who thinks that bad things are more likely to happen or who emphasises the bad part of a situation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., 'Pessimist'.

Key Points

  • Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options:-  
    • Complainer - a person who expresses dissatisfaction or annoyance about something. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी बात पर असंतोष या झुंझलाहट व्यक्त करता हो)
    • Optimist - a person who believes that this world is the best of all possible worlds or that good must ultimately prevail over evil. (आशावादी)
    • Misanthropist - a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society. (मानवद्वेषी)
    • Pessimist - a person who believes that this world is as bad as it could be or that evil will ultimately prevail over good. (निराशावादी)
  • From the above meanings, it is clear that pessimist is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
  • Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A dynamic campaign for political, social or religious change
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A dynamic campaign for political, social or religious change
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Crusade.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Conflict - a fight or an argument. (किसी बात पर झगड़ा, संघर्ष या विवाद)
    • Mutiny - an act of a group of people refusing to obey the person who is in command. (व्‍यक्तियों का अधिकारी के आदेश को मानने से इनकार; बग़ावत, ग़दर)
    • War - a state of fighting between different countries or groups within countries using armies and weapons. (देशों में या देश के भीतर गुटों में लड़ाई, युद्घ)
    • Crusade - a vigorous campaign for political, social, or religious change. (राजनीतिक, सामाजिक या धार्मिक परिवर्तन के लिए एक जोरदार अभियान)
      ​

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. An imaginary ideal society free of poverty and suffering
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An imaginary ideal society free of poverty and suffering
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Utopia.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Heaven - the place where, in some religions, it is believed that God lives and where good people go when they die. (स्‍वर्ग)
    • Utopia - an imaginary ideal society free of poverty and suffering. (गरीबी और पीड़ा से मुक्त एक काल्पनिक आदर्श समाज; कल्‍पनालोक, आदर्श-लोक, रामराज्‍य)
    • Dreamland - an imagined and unrealistically ideal world. (एक काल्पनिक और अवास्तविक रूप से आदर्श दुनिया)
    • Paradise - the perfect place where some people think that good people go after they die. (स्‍वर्ग)
      ​

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. One who does not believe in the existence of God.
questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Atheist.'

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A number which is used to divide another number
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A number which is used to divide another number
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Divisor.

Key Points

  • The word "Divisor" means a number by which another number is to be divided. (भाजक)
  • ​"Divisor" is a mathematical term used for the number that divides another number without leaving a remainder. (भाजक)
    • Example: In the division of 20 by 4, the number 4 is the divisor.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Divisible (भाज्य): Capable of being divided by another number without leaving a remainder.
    • Example: 10 is divisible by 2.
  • Quotient (भागफल): The result obtained by dividing one number by another.
    • Example: In 12 ÷ 4 = 3, the number 3 is the quotient.
  • Remainder (शेषफल): The amount left over after division when one number does not divide the other exactly.
    • Example: When 17 is divided by 5, the remainder is 2.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A creature which depends on others
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A creature which depends on others
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Parasite.

Key Points

  • The word "Parasite" means a creature that depends on others for its survival. (परजीवी)
  • ​"Parasite" refers to an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.
    • Example: Ticks are parasites that can transmit diseases to animals and humans.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Microbes (सूक्ष्मजीव): Microorganisms, especially bacteria, that cause disease or fermentation.
    • Example: The scientist studied various microbes under the microscope.
  • Virus (विषाणु): A small infectious agent that replicates only inside the living cells of an organism.
    • Example: The flu is caused by a type of virus.
  • Bacteria (जीवाणु): Single-celled microorganisms that can exist either as independent organisms or as parasites.
    • Example: Bacteria in the gut help in the digestion of food.
